_doc: Machine-readable methodology statement for the Muntin Cost Index — the versioned, citable specification a reader (or auditor, or LLM) can resolve. A faithful mirror of /cost-index/methodology/; the human page renders the version and change log from this file via sentinels (scripts/build-cost-index-methodology.mjs --check keeps them in lockstep). No claim here that is not on the page.
scope: Weekly wholesale reference prices for common restaurant ingredients in the United States, from public market data only. Measured levels, measured directions, and an inferred directional-pressure overlay — never a price forecast.

sources.name: USDA AMS Market News (terminal & national reports)
USDA National Dairy Product Sales Report

dataClasses.measured: A published government series, shown as-is.
dataClasses.derived: Our own estimate from public inputs, drawn with a dashed line, a confidence band, and an estimate badge — via a validated historical-ratio bridge (cointegration-gated).
dataClasses.absent: No credible public series exists; a greyed card names the structural reason instead of inventing a number.

specification.summary: What each published price represents: a wholesale reference, not a delivered or retail price.

sourcing.summary: Public U.S. market data only; every number traces to a dated public report.

pipeline.summary: Fetch → normalize → quality-screen → composite → fact-gated vendor.

confidence.summary: Level and trend scored separately; the headline is the lower of the two; a calibration ceiling caps every label and is proven on each build.

shippableBar.summary: Ship a credible wholesale level (measured cross-market range OR a single authoritative source with corroborated, non-noisy direction), or do not ship.

freshness.summary: Every value stores its vintage; a print overdue for its source's own cadence is marked down; old is not the same as overdue.

derivedMethods.summary: Labeled estimates via a cointegration-gated historical-ratio bridge; never a measurement, degrade to absent when inputs fail the bar.

pressure.summary: Leading-indicator overlay published as inferred direction only, never a price, and only once a rule clears a hold-until-proven bar.

revisionPolicy.summary: Source revisions are re-vendored with a new vintage and recorded in the public revisions ledger; corrections that change a published reading are logged; discontinued series go absent, never frozen.

governance.summary: Methodology versioned with the code; this statement is the machine mirror. Fact discipline is absolute: every figure is a published source value, a labeled derived estimate, or labeled illustrative. Reproducibility is the citable asset.

limitations.summary: Public-data ceiling on poultry/egg granularity and daily seafood; derived-method lag; yield ranges; seasonal thinness; no forecast.

change.en: Formalized the machine-readable methodology statement and published the public revisions/audit-trail ledger at /cost-index/revisions.json. No change to how any reading is assessed.
change.es: Se formalizó la declaración de metodología legible por máquina y se publicó el registro público de revisiones en /cost-index/revisions.json. Sin cambios en cómo se evalúa ninguna lectura.
